reflectors.description:
The AmComm DMR Network offers several compelling reasons for amateur radio enthusiasts to join:

 

  • Global Connectivity: With multiple interconnected servers worldwide, you can communicate seamlessly across continents.
  • Community Focus: It was created by ham radio operators who value respect and camaraderie, fostering a friendly and inclusive environment.
  • Ease of Use: No account is needed—just a callsign, DMR ID, and a connection to one of our master servers.
  • Learning Opportunities: It's a great platform to experiment and learn more about amateur radio and enhance your skills.

 

If you're into amateur radio, this is a fantastic way to connect and grow!  Need help? Please Call 888-944-4334 Ext. 103 for any help you need.

reflectors.description:
We’re not just another DMR network; we’re a community-driven platform that champions:

 

  • Openness to Innovation: Have a unique idea for a talkgroup? Want to experiment with data modes? Digital Voice DMR provides a welcoming environment for you to try it out.
  •  
  • Flexibility and Adaptability: Our infrastructure is designed to be nimble, allowing for quicker implementation of new features and protocols.
  •  
  • A “Try It and See” Mentality: We encourage healthy experimentation, even if it means occasional bumps along the road. Learning and growth are paramount.
  •  
  • Collaboration and Knowledge Sharing: We envision a vibrant community where users share their discoveries, troubleshoot challenges together, and collectively advance the capabilities of digital communications.

reflectors.description:
The Extended Freedom Network is a Multimode Amateur Radio Network allowing a diverse range of Amateur Operators to come together via different and normally incompatible modes, with connections spanning the globe to bring people together making those QSO's happen.

You can connect to the Extended Freedom Network via a number of ways. Our primary route is via the Allstar system, node no’s. 2195 & 2197.

We have connectivity using EchoLink, DMR, Yaesu Fusion (YSF), Teamspeak, Hamshack Hotline and our own VoIP Network Extended Freedom SIP.

reflectors.description:
FreeDMR Central America is an independent regional DMR network connecting FreeDMR/HBLink servers and licensed amateur radio operators across Central America. The network operates 24/7 and provides regional, national, and international DMR connectivity through an interconnected infrastructure based on FreeDMR technology.


The network is open to licensed amateur radio operators and promotes cooperation and interoperability between FreeDMR systems throughout Central America, while maintaining connectivity with international DMR networks.

reflectors.description:
FreeDMR Network.

The FreeDMR Network is a group of independent servers running the FreeDMR Peer Server Software. The FreeDMR Peer Servers are connected via OpenBridge “OPB” connections in a Mesh topology to one another to redundantly and diversely share all available TalkGroups among all Servers. The FreeDMR Network, does NOT utilize a “Master/Slave” topology. All FreeDMR peer servers are seen as equal peers to each other just as all the individuals who run the servers are. We do not control when where, what how or who can use our software. Free means free as in speech and free as in beer!.

reflectors.description:
AETHER HELLAS is an experimental Greek DMR digital voice project.

Initiated and currently operated by a licensed radio amateur,
it openly invites fellow system operators to interconnect and collaborate,
as well as licensed radio amateurs to connect via hotspots
for testing, experimentation and on-air communication.

What is "Aether Hellas"?

In Greek Mythology, Aether was the personification of the upper air breathed by the Gods. In early physics, it was believed to be the medium that fills the universe, allowing waves to propagate through space.
For us, Aether Hellas represents the "invisible web" that connects Greece to the world. It is our digital gateway that transforms the air into communication, bridging the distances between Rhodes, Thessaly, and Central Greece, uniting people and technology under a shared amateur radio vision.

  • Name: HB_GR_ΑΕΤΗΕR HELLAS NET

  • ID: 0000

  • Address/Host: svham.eu (38.19.202.24)

  • Password: passw0rd

  • Port: 53000

  • Type: HBLink

  • Description: HB_GR_ΑΕΤΗΕR HELLAS NET HBLINK DMR SERVER

  • The first independent HBLink DMR Server in Greece – AETHER HELLAS NET, dedicated to promoting digital voice communication and HBLink technology.

reflectors.description:
Değerli Amatör Telsizciler,

Türkiye'deki amatör telsizcilik faaliyetlerine destek olmak ve dijital haberleşmeyi daha erişilebilir kılmak amacıyla, camiamıza tamamen ücretsiz ve kesintisiz hizmet verecek yeni nesil DMR ağımızı duyurmaktan büyük bir heyecan duyuyoruz!

Hiçbir ticari kaygı gütmeden, dayanışma ve teknolojik gelişim odağıyla kurulan bu sistemin kalbinde DMRHub altyapısı yatıyor.

Neden Bizim Ağımızı Tercih Etmelisiniz?

Ağımız, amatör telsizcilerin ihtiyaçlarına yönelik olarak özel olarak yapılandırılmış modern bir teknik altyapıya sahiptir:

  • Açık Kaynak Gücü (DMRHub): Sistemimiz, açık kaynak kodlu (open-source) bir DMR ağ sunucusu olan DMRHub temel alınarak inşa edilmiştir. Şeffaf ve sürekli geliştirilebilir bir yapı sunar.

  • MMDVM ve Homebrew Uyumluluğu: Homebrew röle protokolünü (repeater protocol) kullanan ağımız, sahip olduğunuz tüm MMDVM ve benzeri hotspot/röle cihazlarıyla doğrudan ve kusursuz bir şekilde uyumlu çalışır.

  • Kullanıcı Dostu, Güçlü Bir Alternatif: BrandMeister ve TGIF gibi mevcut küresel ağların karmaşıklığından uzak; açık kaynaklı ve kullanımı çok daha kolay bir alternatif sunma fikriyle yola çıktık.

  • Yerel ve Bağımsız Haberleşme (AREDN Mesh): Ağımız, özellikle AREDN mesh gibi yerel haberleşme ağları üzerinden kesintisiz ve bağımsız bir şekilde çalışmak üzere tasarlanmıştır. Bu sayede, hem günlük yerel QSO'larınızda hem de afet/acil durum haberleşmelerinde yerel (local) iletişim ortamlarında maksimum verim alırsınız.

Hedefimiz Nedir?

Amacımız, Türk amatör telsiz camiasındaki her operatörün, yüksek kaliteli bir dijital ses deneyimine hiçbir ücret ödemeden, kolayca ulaşabilmesidir. İster yeni bir lisanslı operatör olun ister yıllarını bu hobiye vermiş bir usta; bu ağ hepimizin ortak buluşma noktası olmak için tasarlandı.

Cihazlarınızı ayarlayın, MMDVM sistemlerinizi yönlendirin ve bu açık kaynaklı, yerel ve güçlü ağın bir parçası olun!

Havada görüşmek dileğiyle... 73!
